title: lathyrus luteus subsp. occidentalis
intro: Lathyrus luteus subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western yellow peavine, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus luteus subsp. occidentalis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
